main_text.p: tionemque reuocantur. Ex his Ciceronis uerbis illud in primis debet intelligi, uim huius artificiosæ tractationis quam Hermagoream appellamus, hanc esse, ut propositam controuersiam semper ab hypothesi ad thesim, hoc est à specie ad genus reuocet: quod exemplo familiari commonstrabimus ex eo Institutionū capite, quod paulo superius partitione explicatum est. Titius suam arborem im prudens in Mæuij solo conse-uit. antequam ea radices e-gisset, admonitus, id suum solum non esse, euellere illam instituit. Mæuius prohibet.

page.notes: The running head at top right is a decorative black block with a few letters that cannot be read. The word after "Mæuij" is written with a cedilla-like mark under the æ; read as Mæuij, doubtful. "im prudens" is printed with a space and is copied as such. The paragraph beginning "L.item" continues onto the next page. A small mark below "L.item" is not text and is not transcribed.
